policy.memory: RSS samples; includes generator input, source snapshot, indexes, answers, runtime; not isolated index bytes
policy.first: first for this query, not guaranteed cold runtime or OS cache
policy.read: complete navigation + one page; per-method timing overhead included; hashing/serialization excluded
policy.serialization: source response envelopes separately, final view without sourceFacts; not a chosen wire protocol
policy.fixedOrder: nodes then free; selectivity all, 10%, 1%, one, none; candidates alternate order by run
policy.interference: ordinary interactive host, not isolated or CPU-pinned; no caches cleared
